structured_output.rationale: All four lines denied CO-16 with MOA N286 (missing/invalid referring provider primary identifier). The 837P has no referring provider loop — billing and rendering provider are present but no ordering/referring NPI. Medicare Part B FFS; claim adjudicated (835 with CLP07 2626660924906). New original claim required with correct referring provider NPI.

root_cause.explanation: 837P contains no referring/ordering provider loop. MOA N286 on every line confirms the referring provider NPI is absent. CO-16 is the defect carrier; N286 names the specific missing element.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering/referring provider name and NPI (verify against NPI Registry and PECOS). Resubmit as new original CLM05-3=1 — Medicare Part B does not accept frequency 7. Do not appeal; do not bill patient.
